content.text: {"id": "mm7034a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2020, 140 cases of WPV1 were reported, including 56 in Afghanistan (a 93% increase from 29 cases in 2019)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "WPV1 was detected in 434 (52%) of 830 sewage samples collected in 2020"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Afghanistan reported 308 cVDPV2 cases in 2020 compared with no cases in 2019."}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "WPV1 was detected in 434 (52%) of 830 sewage samples collected in 2020"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "WPV1 was detected in 434 (52%) of 830 sewage samples collected in 2020"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Pakistan reported 84 WPV1 cases from 39 districts in 2020, representing a 43% decrease from the 147 cases reported in 43 districts during 2019."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "WPV and cVDPV transmission are detected primarily through surveillance for acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) among children aged <15 years"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from five of 176 (3%) in 2019 to 18 of 140 (13%) in 2020"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "GPEI is focusing efforts on two goals: interrupting persistent WPV1 transmission in Pakistan and Afghanistan and stopping all current outbreaks of cVDPV2."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "orphan WPV1 isolates (those with ≤98.5% genetic identity with other isolates)"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
